Number 2933968239 Description: To provide all labour, equipment, materials and supervision for the roof replacement and repair for the Utility Building 22B Centre Island, on behalf of the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division of the City of Toronto. Recommended Supplier: Brook Construction Limited Contract Award Value: $ 1,692,479 net of all applicable taxes and charges $ 1,912,501 including HST and all applicable charges $ 1,722,266 net of HST recoveries The contract is expected to start following the date of award and end by May, 2022.
